lesson.menu_desc: Reading about the day of a technology director, from the first meeting to the gym -- present simple with he and she + always, usually, sometimes, never
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 4 -- A Long Day
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ender de Souza Batista | Lesson 4 -- A Long Day
lesson.grammar_point: present simple with he, she and it (-s, does / doesn't) + adverbs of frequency (always, usually, sometimes, never)

listenings.text: My day starts early. I get up at six, and I am at the office at eight. I always have a call with the team at nine. I usually have lunch at my desk, because I am busy. I don't go to the gym. I walk home: it is forty minutes. At night, I sometimes read, but I am usually tired.

My manager is Anil. He always starts work at nine. In the morning, he has meetings with our team in Pune. In the afternoon, he usually answers emails. At night, he has calls with the US, because it is morning there. He is always busy, and he is often tired. But he never works on Sundays. On Sundays, he plays cricket with his son.

extra_audio.text: He usually gets up early. At the office, he has a lot of meetings. He has lunch at 1:20. After the office, he goes to the gym. He gets home at ten, and he is tired.

paras: Ender is a technology director in São Paulo. His day is always busy. He usually gets up early, because the morning is his quiet time. He gets to the office before the other directors.

At the office, he has a lot of meetings. The meetings often change time. A meeting with the CEO at 10:30 goes to 11:00, and then to 11:30. Ender sometimes has lunch at 1:20. He never has a long lunch.
He usually leaves the office at eight or eight thirty. Then he goes to the gym: it is his time to relax. He gets home at ten. He is tired, but he doesn't watch TV. He likes music more.
